mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO eval_result (run_id, question_id, position, question, knowledge_base_id, expectation, match_mode, expected_document_ids, expected_documents) VALUES
(#{row.runId}, #{row.questionId}, #{row.position}, #{row.question}, #{row.knowledgeBaseId}, #{row.expectation}, #{row.matchMode}, #{row.expectedDocumentIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::bigint[], #{row.expectedDocuments, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::text[])
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_result SET passed = #{row.passed}, refused = #{row.refused}, recalled_document_ids = #{row.recalledDocumentIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::bigint[], cited_document_ids = #{row.citedDocumentIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::bigint[], cited_documents = #{row.citedDocuments, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::text[], answer_text = #{row.answerText} WHERE run_id = #{row.runId} AND question_id = #{row.questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, question_id, position, question, knowledge_base_id, expectation, match_mode, expected_document_ids, expected_documents, passed, refused, recalled_document_ids, cited_document_ids, cited_documents, answer_text FROM eval_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY position
